''lo fagri cu xunre i lo grusi cu rokci''

'''Read the statements. What colors are the various substances in the picture? Answer in lojban.'''


New Words:

''rokci'' - x<sub>1</sub> is/contains rock/stone of type/composition x<sub>2</sub> from location x<sub>3</sub>. 

''bisli'' - x<sub>1</sub> is/contains ice [frozen crystal] of composition/material x<sub>2</sub>. 

''dertu'' - x<sub>1</sub> is/contains dirt/earth from source x<sub>2</sub> of composition x<sub>3</sub>. 

''srasu'' - x<sub>1</sub> is a blade/expanse of grass of species x<sub>2</sub> 

''vacri'' - x<sub>1</sub> is a quantity of air/atmosphere of planet x<sub>2</sub>, of composition including x<sub>3</sub>. 

''fagri'' - x<sub>1</sub> is a fire in fuel x<sub>2</sub> burning-in/reacting-with oxidizer x<sub>3</sub> (default air/oxygen).

''djacu'' - x<sub>1</sub> is made of/contains/is a quantity/expanse of water

''cu'' - verb separator

'''Answer:''' <span style="color:gray;background:gray;">lo rokci cu gruci i lo fagri cu xunre i lo dertu cu bunre i lo vacri cu cicna i lo djacu cu blanu i lo srasu cu crino fa'o The ice (AKA «lo bisli») is a trick question since it is transparent which we haven't gone through.</span>
